purpose: Machine-readable DevSecOps gap ledger for CYNIC network and infrastructure health. This file records open control gaps; runtime truth remains observed by cynic-node.

gaps.risk: Network diagnosis and planning now have a bounded helper/policy/sudoers bundle surface, but that actuator is not yet installed and proved on runtime nodes.
done_when: network-actuator plan emits JSON without mutating the host
network-actuator apply requires an explicit apply flag and root policy
network-actuator apply records before/after cynic-node network evidence
all applied actions are idempotent or have a rollback command

gaps.risk: Registry, MCP contracts, or infrastructure surfaces may still designate a deprecated network organ as owner or implementation.
done_when: network_policy owner no longer points to deprecated organ ownership
MCP network tools route diagnostics to cynic-node or an explicit diagnostic adapter
MCP mutation tools route application to network-actuator only
legacy organ paths are marked deprecated or removed from active desired state

gaps.risk: Network remediation now has a structured least-privilege root policy plus helper/sudoers bundle surface, but denial proofs and runtime installation are not yet materialized on target nodes.
done_when: allowed network commands are enumerated as structured data
sudoers projection is generated from the structured policy
commands outside the allowlist fail non-interactively
cynic-node repair plans identify which actions require root

gaps.risk: cynic-node can emit evidence, but no actuator is required to collect before/after proof yet.
done_when: every network-actuator apply requires preflight cynic-node network evidence
every apply captures postflight cynic-node network evidence
delta status is published to the Kernel observation path
failed postflight evidence blocks success reporting

gaps.risk: cynic-node runtime now attests the launched binary, but forge-built provenance, declared installation path, and deployment proof are not yet enforced.
done_when: forge build publishes cynic-node artifact hash
systemd unit runs the declared artifact path
cynic-node observe emits build hash and artifact path
watchdog observations include artifact attestation

gaps.risk: Provider fallback is currently the live resurrection path; canonical Synapse is not self-sustaining yet.
done_when: cynic-node observe status is mesh_active
provider fallback route is no longer required for critical service TCP checks
DNS critical hosts resolve to canonical Synapse addresses
watchdog reports clear network severity on every active critical node
